headlines.summary: 국토부, 매물잠김 해소조치 매수자는 무주택자로 제한 정부가 토지거래허가구역(토허구역)에서 주택 매수자에게 적용되는 실거주 의무를 세입자가 있는 모든 주택을 대상으로 연말까지 한시 유예한다. 다만 매수자가 무주택자인 경우로 제한된다. 지난 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예조치 종료 후 시장에서 매물 잠김 현상이 발생하자 이를 해소하려는 조치로 해석된다.

headlines.title: 비거주 1주택자도 전 세 낀 매도 허용…"양도세 따져봐야"
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워에서 바라본 강남3구 아파트 모습. 이재명 대통령이 다주택자는 물론 비거주 1주택자가 보유한 주택에 대해서도 5월 9일까지 토지거래 허가를 신청할 경우 전월세를 끼고 집을 팔 수 있도록 허용하겠다고 밝히면서 최근 감소 추세로 돌아선 서울의 주택 매물이 다시 증가하는 모습을 보입니다.

headlines.title: 오늘부터 비거주 1주택 ‘ 세 낀 매물 ’도 매도 허용
headlines.summary: 정부 연말까지 토허구역 내 ‘세 낀 매물’ 매도 허용 매수자 무주택자 한정, 최대 2년 실거주 유예 적용 최근 서울 강남구 압구정동의 한 부동산에 급매물 가격표가 부착되어 있다. 임세준 기자 [헤럴드경제=홍승희 기자] 오늘부터 토지거래허가구역 내 1주택자가 임대 중인 주택도 매매거래를 할 수 있게 됐다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 경제 흐름 요약

미국 노동시장이 점차 약화되고 있다는 신호가 감지되는 가운데, 채권시장에서는 매파적 기조가 여전히 강하게 지배하며 금리 인하 기대를 압도하는 흐름이 이어지고 있다. 영국에서는 총리 거취를 둘러싼 정치적 불확실성이 국채 금리 급등으로 이어지며 재정 리스크에 대한 시장의 민감도가 높아진 상황을 드러냈다. 외환시장에서는 달러 강세 위협이 실질적인 파급력을 갖지 못하는 '공허한 위협'에 그치고 있다는 분석이 나오는 한편, 대외경제정책연구원은 원·달러 환율이 하반기로 갈수록 안정세를 찾아갈 것으로 전망하면서도 방향성보다는 변동성 관리에 방점을 두어야 한다고 강조했다. 종합하면, 글로벌 긴축 기조의 장기화와 각국의 정치·경제적 불안이 맞물리며 시장 변동성이 높게 유지되는 환경 속에서, 한국 경제는 환율 안정화를 위한 선제적 리스크 관리가 그 어느 때보다 중요한 시점을 맞이하고 있다.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic momentum strengthened significantly with Q1 GDP growth of 1.694% ranking first among 22 tracked countries, driven by semiconductor earnings surprises. However, US inflation concerns are mounting as April CPI rose to 3.8%, the highest in 3 years, triggering a global semiconductor stock selloff. The Korea Financial Research Institute raised its 2026 growth forecast to 2.8% from 2.1%, reflecting optimism about supplementary budgets and semiconductor sector tailwinds. Interest rate expectations are shifting as market participants price in potential rate hikes rather than cuts, amid inflation concerns and strong growth data. Energy price increases are beginning to show up in inflation metrics, creating mixed signals for monetary policy decisions.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's macroeconomic outlook has improved significantly with the Financial Research Institute raising its 2026 growth forecast to 2.8%, up from 2.1%, citing rapid supplementary budget execution and semiconductor industry support. Unemployment is expected to remain at 2.9% with job creation forecast at 170,000, though slightly lower than previous expectations. Consumer price inflation is projected at 2.4% for H1 and 2.7% for H2, averaging 2.6% for the full year, with Middle East geopolitical risks contributing to oil price pressures. Korean central bank officials continue expressing inflation concerns, shifting market expectations from rate cuts to potential rate hikes. President Lee Jae-myung emphasized aggressive fiscal spending as essential for economic growth, noting that previous consumption stimulus vouchers generated 430,000 won in additional economic benefits per 1 million won spent.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean equity markets experienced divergent performance with KOSPI sustaining its rally, attempting to break through 7,900, while KOSDAQ saw consistent outflows as retail investors shift capital to large-cap semiconductor stocks. US inflation concerns triggered profit-taking in semiconductor shares globally, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 3%, dampening the AI-driven rally that dominated recent months. Korean government bond yields surged, with 3-year yields marking new highs as markets price in potential rate hikes following strong GDP data and inflation concerns. Bond fund performance lagged stocks significantly, with limited investor appetite as inflation risks and potential rate hikes diminish safe-asset appeal. US Treasury yields extended gains, with 30-year bonds breaking through 5% amid inflation fears and recession concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: The electric vehicle industry faces supply chain disruption risks from Hormuz Strait tensions, threatening critical battery component supplies and potentially halting production. Samsung Electronics faces competitive pressure from China's advancing semiconductor capabilities, with Korea's semiconductor leadership increasingly vulnerable without proper AI manufacturing integration. Volkswagen's ID.4 encountered dual challenges with refrigerant system issues and high-voltage battery recalls, raising concerns about EV product reliability and consumer confidence. The government is introducing battery subscription models allowing EV buyers to lease batteries separately from vehicles, reducing upfront purchase costs and addressing affordability concerns. Elderly investors are increasingly participating in cryptocurrency markets, with those over 70 showing 5.8% growth in participation, marking a shift from youth-dominated adoption patterns.
sections.Real Estate: May apartment sales outlook improved dramatically, with the index rising 19.1 points to 80.0 as surging jeonse prices stimulated home purchase sentiment and developer confidence. Apartment lease and sales listings are tightening considerably as government policies permitting non-resident single-home owners to sell taxed properties are reducing rental inventory. Rising jeonse prices and restricted rental inventory are intensifying tenant housing anxiety, with landlords expected to raise monthly rent prices following capital gains tax increases on multiple property owners. Illegal apartment subscription contracts gained attention as brokers capitalized on soaring property prices, with cases emerging of fraudulent applications for special supply allocations. Total apartment lease and rental listings in Seoul declined significantly to 31,448 units, reflecting structural market imbalances between buyers and renters.
sections.International Economy: The US federal appeals court temporarily halted the effect of the lower court's ruling that deemed Trump's 10% global tariffs illegal, allowing tariffs to remain in effect during the appellate process. Trump administration postponed cattle tariff relief measures due to farmer opposition, despite high beef prices and inflation concerns, highlighting political constraints on trade policy adjustments. The global tariff regime faces uncertainty as it is limited to late July, requiring the administration to pursue Section 301 investigations to establish replacement tariffs and maintain trade policy continuity. Federal Reserve leadership transitions continued with Senate confirmation of a new Fed board member, with chair succession likely from June 16-17 FOMC meetings. Trade policy uncertainty persists as the administration navigates between using tariffs for inflation control and managing support from agricultural constituencies.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea achieved the world's fastest generative AI adoption growth rate at 6.4 percentage points quarter-over-quarter, ranking 16th globally with 37.1% usage rate, demonstrating rapid AI integration across industries. Pohang City launched initiatives to build 'Physical AI' infrastructure, supporting local AI company development, talent cultivation, and recruitment to drive regional economic growth. Finance Minister Yi Eok-won visited Furiosa AI, a domestic AI semiconductor company, to review National Growth Fund investment opportunities and strengthen Korea's AI ecosystem. Domestic AI chip companies are positioned as critical assets for AI sovereignty, with government financial support mechanisms designed to nurture venture capital and patient capital strategies. The AI semiconductor industry, particularly neural processing units (NPUs), represents Korea's last remaining competitive advantage as traditional semiconductor dominance faces challenges from China.
sections.Others: The US Senate Banking Committee advanced comprehensive cryptocurrency regulation through the 'Clarity Act,' establishing unified oversight of stablecoins, DeFi, and NFTs under SEC and CFTC authority. Korea Electric Power Corporation maintained its position as the only state-owned enterprise to achieve 12 consecutive years of inclusion in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Asia-Pacific Index, reflecting strong ESG performance recognition. Heungkuk Securities raised Samsung C&T's target price from 400,000 won to 580,000 won, citing increased subsidiary valuations and NAV discount adjustments as the company shifts toward energy business expansion. LS Cable completed its Gunsan factory as part of eco-friendly material business expansion, enhancing competitiveness in global wire and battery markets through advanced copper foil materials. President Lee emphasized that current economic conditions warrant aggressive fiscal spending and consumer investment rather than austerity, citing substantial economic multiplier effects from government stimulus programs.
